thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — sudden spike: 4xx/5xx surge for tenant 'astraeus-corp' (enterprise / VPC / eu-west-1 dedicated pool). Error rate 18% over 5m, tail latency +400ms. Affected route: /v1/generate. Creating incident channel and paging on-call.

sre-olivia: Ack — I'm oncall. @net-nadia can you check edge/BGP? @eng-kevin look at dedicated pool nodes (eu-west-1). @prod-ops-maya please get Astraeus CS on the line.

net-nadia: Looking at edge telemetry now. No widespread AS flaps, but egress path to eu-west edge shows packet loss ~2-3% over 10m. Starting pings to customer VPC endpoint and edge eBGP peers.

eng-kevin: Dedicated pool: several model workers on shard-7 showing OOMs and connection resets. No deploys in last 24h. Pulling worker logs and `systemd` coredumps.

prod-ops-maya: CS notified Astraeus. They confirm degraded 5xxs and throughput loss. Astraeus ops on standby; schedule window in 2h, but they want immediate mitigation.

customer-ops-astrid: Confirmed on our side — users experiencing timeouts. Please provide ETA ASAP.

sre-olivia: Immediate mitigation plan (T-0):
1) Isolate Astraeus traffic to reduce noisy-neighbor impact.
2) Activate warm pool in eu-central-1 and shift traffic (canary -> ramp -> cutover).
3) If routing requires, perform DNS CNAME swap (short TTL) for clean TLS/certs.
4) If unsuccessful, fallback to per-route rate-limiting for tenant.

net-nadia: We can do either edge path route or DNS. TLS cert pinning on customer's side means DNS CNAME is cleaner. TTL currently 300s, will lower to 60s before swap.

eng-kevin: Taking immediate steps on hosts: restarting stuck workers on shard-7, disabling tenant-level kv-cache to reduce memory pressure.`cmd: rictl tenant update --id astraeus-corp --set cache.enabled=false`

prod-ops-maya: Activating warm pool in eu-central-1 now: `rictl warm activate --pool eu-central-1 --profile astraeus-corp --count 6` — started. ETA ~90s.

deploy-bot: Warm pool activation job queued by prod-ops-maya. Job ID: wp-66421. Estimated ready in 1m30s.

eng-kevin: Rolling restart on shard-7: `for id in 71 72 73 74 75 76 77 78; do rictl infra restart worker $id || echo "restart failed $id"; done` — two workers showing CrashLoopBackOff. Opening infra ticket to reallocate resources.

net-nadia: Lowering DNS TTL: `dnsctl set-ttl astraeus.example.com 60` — applying. Propagation underway.

cs-luke: Sent update to Astraeus support with current plan (warm pool + DNS cutover if canary healthy). They've assigned internal SRE on standby.

eng-kevin: Warm pool healthy. Backend healthchecks passing. Preparing canary at 5%. `rictl route shift --tenant astraeus-corp --to eu-central-1 --weight 5`

prod-ops-maya: Canary applied. Observing metrics.

sre-olivia: Monitoring: eu-west error rate lowered to 9% (from 18%). Canary in eu-central 1.2% errors, latency stable. Proceed to ramp to 30% over next 3m.

net-nadia: Verified staging CNAME mapping and certs; prod swap ready on go.

eng-kevin: FYI — kv-cache bypass increases token throughput cost but reduces OOM risk; will keep off until stability maintained for 30m.

prod-ops-maya: Ramped to 30% — now at ~31%. eu-central error 1.0%, eu-west aggregate 6%.

customer-ops-astrid: Astraeus ops confirms they can accept a short cert swap if needed. Their SRE is on standby for any client-side changes.

sre-olivia: Ramp to 70% now. After 70% I'll trigger DNS cutover so edge rules don't grow complex.

net-nadia: 70% reached. Initiating DNS CNAME swap: updating `CNAME astraeus.example.com -> astraeus-euc.e-cust.ri.redwood.net`. TTL 60s.

incident-bot: DNS change observed by resolver check within 10s.

cs-luke: Notified customer that cutover is in progress; expected finalization within 2 minutes.

eng-kevin: Full traffic now routed to eu-central. Monitoring 5m window. No further worker crashes post-restart; memory metrics stable.

sre-olivia: :white_check_mark: Stabilized — error rate 0.9% over 5m, latency within SLO. Actions: keep kv-cache disabled for 30m, repro shard-7 crashes, and schedule RCA.

prod-ops-maya: Creating follow-ups: ticket INF-1927 for shard-7 fleet repro; ops task OPS-334 for controlled cache reenable.

cs-luke: Customer informed and thanked the team. We'll deliver a formal RCA within 24h.

net-nadia: Will restore TTL to 300s in 1h if no regressions.

sre-olivia: Handoff: @eng-kevin owner for RCA and infra fixes, @cs-luke owner for customer comms. If any regression, page SRE via primary.

customer-ops-astrid: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. Will update internal stakeholders.

deploy-bot: Incident closed by sre-olivia. Duration: 18m. Link: https://incidents.ri.redwood.net/1738201111
